decisions.reason: The candidate already requires help text in both the label and field and requires it to persist when the field is empty, so the source adds no necessary state change.
Visibility of help text in an empty field does not change the Title field's formatting-retention behavior.
The source governs visual guidance for empty fields, not the underlying editable-text representation or architecture.
Retaining visible guidance in an empty field does not alter the requirement that field instances contain independent, nonduplicated user content.
The source requires guidance to remain visible when editable content is empty but does not revoke or modify the separate behavior of clearing placeholder content upon activation.
The source changes visibility of existing help text, not its language, translation coverage, or wording.
The empty-field guidance decision does not change whether the Board Meeting dropdown control is enabled.
The source does not change the calendar-dropdown selection method for date fields.
The source does not change the checklist control type or its enabled status.
Interactive-field guidance visibility is unrelated to pasted-table structure or column containment.
The source establishes a specific interactive-field visibility rule but does not modify the general supported environment or cross-user rendering requirement.
The empty-field help-text decision has no effect on numbered-list alignment or formatting.
